name: io.github.GeminiGeorge22/spotify-play-count-mcp
title: Spotify Play Count MCP: Plays & Monthly Listeners
description: Spotify play counts for any track, album, artist or playlist, plus monthly listeners and followers.

headers.description: Optional if you use Apify OAuth. Otherwise: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN> (your own Apify API token).
